outcome: Methylation of mitochondrial loci (D-loop, mt-TF/RNR1, mt-CO1)
cohort: 35 term and 8 preterm control, 31 IUGR, 17 PE/IUGR, and 17 PE human singleton pregnancies
finding: IUGR, PE/IUGR, and PE were associated with increased mtDNA levels and hypomethylation of mitochondrial loci in fetal cord blood, suggesting a fetal response to placental insufficiency.
